scripts.start:v3: cross-env EXT_MANIFEST_V3=1 WEB_PORT=3180 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" rspack serve --config-loader jiti
scripts.build:v3: yarn clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=production EXT_MANIFEST_V3=1 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" rspack build --config-loader jiti && node ./scripts/finalize-production-assets.js && node ./scripts/check-build-output.js
scripts.stats:v3: yarn clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=production EXT_MANIFEST_V3=1 RSPACK_FULL_STATS=1 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" rspack build --config-loader jiti --json=build/rspack-stats.json
